entities.summary: Abraha, a notable figure in the history of Saudi Arabia, associated with Pre-Islamic Arabia and Jahiliyyah (400–610). Preceded by Mecca and the Quraysh and Kindah and Arabian Kingdoms. Their legacy influenced Year of the Elephant — Abraha's Ethiopian army fails to capture Mecca.
